SELECT quotes.id 
FROM quotes 
WHERE quotes.quote_number = ?
 LIMIT ? OFFSET ?

SELECT customers.id, customers.name, customers.address, customers.city_state_zip, customers.phone, customers.email, customers.created_at, customers.updated_at 
FROM customers 
WHERE lower(customers.name) = ?

SELECT quote_line_items.id AS quote_line_items_id, quote_line_items.quote_id AS quote_line_items_quote_id, quote_line_items.reference_part_number AS quote_line_items_reference_part_number, quote_line_items.description AS quote_line_items_description, quote_line_items.quantity AS quote_line_items_quantity, quote_line_items.unit_price AS quote_line_items_unit_price, quote_line_items.extended_price AS quote_line_items_extended_price, quote_line_items.internal_note AS quote_line_items_internal_note, quote_line_items.show_on_customer_quote AS quote_line_items_show_on_customer_quote, quote_line_items.sort_order AS quote_line_items_sort_order 
FROM quote_line_items 
WHERE ? = quote_line_items.quote_id ORDER BY quote_line_items.sort_order
